test_title: PYST 66: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence to make it a meaningful sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.

The quality of students __of an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point.__

options.text: The quality of students in an educational institute is in great importance and a crucial starting point.
The quality of students in an educational institute is of great importance and a crucial starting point.
The quality of students in an educational institute is of great importance and is a crucial start point.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The use of** 'of great importance'** is appropriate to indicate the significance of the students' quality.
 
• 'In great importance' is incorrect usage.
 
• The term 'a crucial starting point' is correct and requires no modification.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The quality of students **in **an educational institute is** of** great importance and a crucial starting point."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A:** The initial phrase 'The quality of students in an educational institute' correctly sets the context.
 
• **B:** The phrase 'is of great importance' accurately conveys the importance of the students' quality.
 
• **C:** The phrase 'a crucial starting point' indicates that the students' quality is fundamental to the institute’s success.
